design.name: 熔心大剑
design.role: 熔心魔将的双手大剑（Unity 资产 SM_BossWeapon_Greatsword，独立挂件，挂本体 socket_sword）
design.brief: The great sword from the user's design sheet (user_concept_molten_warlord.webp, GREAT SWORD / SWORD REAR): a colossal two-handed sword about 3.2 m long; a very broad thick blade of rough dark purple-grey rock with irregular chipped edges and a broken-wedge tip, lava cracks along the blade; a straight dark iron cross guard with copper end caps and a copper ring at its centre, another copper ring around the blade root; a long grip wrapped in dark leather with copper bands; a big round copper ring pommel with a short dark-red tassel.
design.note: 2026-11-01 用户：大剑单独用 Tripo 建模；造型完全照用户设定图

references: user_concept_molten_warlord.webp（用户选定的设定图，PNG 转码后上传当参考）
generation.note: 照原图出的大剑多视图。选第 3 张：正 / 刃口 / 背 / 刃口（背面穗子在另一侧，镜像正确），剑尖朝下竖直，裂纹平涂；其余三张把背面排在第 2 位或两张刃口挨着
